tasks.subject: Task 0: Fix redirect targets in all Shopify API routes
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every Shopify API route redirects to `/app/settings/integrations?shopify=<status>` so query params survive the settings page's internal redirect.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/api/shopify/auth/route.ts`
- Modify: `src/app/api/shopify/callback/route.ts`
- Modify: `src/app/api/shopify/disconnect/route.ts`
- Modify: `src/app/api/shopify/sync/route.ts`
- Modify: `src/app/shopify-connect/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `auth/route.ts`: all 3 `/app/settings?shopify=` redirects → `/app/settings/integrations?shopify=`
- [ ] `callback/route.ts`: all `/app/settings?shopify=` and shop-mismatch URL fixed
- [ ] `disconnect/route.ts`: `buildFailedUrl` + all standalone redirects fixed
- [ ] `sync/route.ts`: every `returnTo ?? "/app/settings"` fallback → `returnTo ?? "/app/settings/integrations"`
- [ ] `shopify-connect/page.tsx`: `install-expired` → `/app/settings/integrations?shopify=install-expired`
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit` → no output.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/api/shopify/auth/route.ts", "src/app/api/shopify/callback/route.ts", "src/app/api/shopify/disconnect/route.ts", "src/app/api/shopify/sync/route.ts", "src/app/shopify-connect/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["all /app/settings?shopify= redirects changed to /app/settings/integrations?shopify=", "tsc passes", "grep finds no remaining old redirect targets"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: StatusBanner component and integrations page wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add dismissible StatusBanner above the Shopify card, wire it into page.tsx, remove old status display from ShopifyConnect/ShopifyManage, and pass return_to in sync form.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/app/settings/integrations/status-banner.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/settings/integrations/integrations.module.css`
- Modify: `src/app/app/settings/integrations/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/settings/integrations/shopify-manage.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/settings/integrations/shopify-connect.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/settings/integrations/sync-submit-form.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Banner renders above card when `?shopify=` present; absent otherwise
- [ ] success/warning/error variants correct
- [ ] Dismiss strips all status params via router.replace
- [ ] sync-ok shows product+order counts when params present
- [ ] old status props removed from ShopifyConnect and ShopifyManage
- [ ] SyncSubmitForm action includes `?return_to=/app/settings/integrations`
- [ ] npx tsc --noEmit passes

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit` → no output.
